description: This file implements a static analysis tool (linter) for checking the alphabetical order of feature gate constants and variables in Go source files, specifically within the Kubernetes project. It also checks for proper ordering of feature gate keys in maps.

methods.name: isTargetFile
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches any of the specified target files based on suffix.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main analysis function that processes files and declarations to check sorting of feature constants and variables.

methods.name: checkFeatureGateMaps
methods.description: Checks if maps with feature gate keys are sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: extractFeatures
methods.description: Extracts feature declarations from a general declaration, including associated comments.

methods.name: sortFeatures
methods.description: Sorts a list of features alphabetically by name.

methods.name: hasOrderChanged
methods.description: Determines if the order of features has changed after sorting.

methods.name: reportSortingIssue
methods.description: Reports a sorting issue with a diff showing the correct order.

methods.name: stripHeader
methods.description: Removes header lines from diff output for clarity.

methods.name: reportMapSortingIssue
methods.description: Reports a sorting issue for map keys with a diff.

methods.name: generateMapSourceCode
methods.description: Generates source code representation of map keys for diff comparison.

methods.name: generateSourceCode
methods.description: Generates source code for feature declarations with comments.
